logsHint: Live stream of plugin log lines (stderr + core.log). Source: EventBus → SSE.
sessionsHint: Live agent sessions from the menu-bar monitor
soundDoneHint: Play a chime when an agent finishes
soundWaitingHint: Alert when an agent needs your input
modeHint: How sessions appear in the bubble
bubbleThemeHint: Bubble colour and shape, plus phrase style — 12 built-in themes
bubblePosHint: Which side of the pet the bubble sits on; the pet stays put and only the bubble moves. Near a screen edge the bubble auto-flips to the other side
bubbleGapHint: Space between the pet and the bubble
previewHint: Post demo events to the local listener
agentsHint: One-click hook install per coding agent
petSheetHint: Sheet URL (rows/columns detected from transparent gaps). For a local image use Upload — it installs as a pet pack and single images render whole
petPackHint: Packs in ~/.opencapx/pets (pet.json + spritesheet, sliced by alpha). Empty falls back to the spritesheet / built-in logo
petPackBroken: Can't display: the sheet has no visible pixels (fully transparent) or failed to decode
petAdvanceHint: Advanced: a single image is drawn whole; a sheet's rows/columns are detected from transparent gaps
petUrlHint: Use a direct image link (e.g. ordinals /content/<id>, not /inscription/<id> which is a web page). Importing downloads it locally.
petUrlErrBadUrl: Only http(s) image links are supported
petUrlErrNotImage: That address returns {detail}, not an image — use a direct image link
petUrlErrLoad: Couldn't load that address (check it's a direct image link, or use Import from URL)
bubbleEnableHint: Master switch for the desktop bubble
bubbleDurationHint: Seconds before the bubble hides, 0 = stay
petVisibleHint: Show or hide the desktop pet
breakReminderHint: Nudge you after long stretches, off by default
sessionContextHint: Inject OpenCapX's capability list into supported agents' context at session start (Claude Code, Codex, Droid, Grok)
breakMessage: Time to stretch — you've been coding for a while!
aboutText: OpenCapX watches your AI coding agents and reacts in real time.
pluginsHint: Installed plugins and their permission decisions
corePermHint: Global policy for core capabilities. It sits above per-agent decisions: a level set here applies to every agent unless that agent has its own override in the Agents tab.
corePermSubscriptionNote: screen.watch shares screen.capture's permission, and file.watch shares file.read's. They are continuous event streams, so they cannot be switched independently of their base permission.
corePermLoadFailed: Could not load the capability policy.
agentsViewHint: Registered agent identities (CLI / MCP callers) and their permission decisions. Revoked agents cannot re-register automatically; use Reauthorize to recover.
agentsNone: No agents registered yet. Run `opencapx mcp` or `opencapx hook` to register one.
agentsRevokeConfirm: Revoke this agent? Its token stops working immediately and automatic re-registration is rejected. Recovery is manual (Reauthorize).
agentsTokenOnce: Copy this token now — it is shown only once and never stored by the UI. Put it into the CLI token file (~/.opencapx/agent-tokens/).
agentsPermHighRiskHint: High-risk permissions cannot be set to Allow permanently; allow once at runtime.
marketHint: Community plugins (set OPENCAPX_MARKETPLACE_URL or drop seed.json in ~/.opencapx/marketplace/)
auditHint: Permission decisions for the last 14 days. The live stream updates in real time.
notifHint: Notifications posted by all agents (opencapx.notify). Unread since last "Mark all read" are highlighted.
automationHint: Event → Rule → Action. Rules live in ~/.opencapx/automation.json and hot-reload on save. Actions are limited to notify and say.
rulesHint: Interception rules that route the agent's shell commands to a wrapper you choose (curl becomes sandbox curl). Rules live in ~/.opencapx/rules.json and hot-reload on save. Project-level rules stay off until you trust that project.
rulesEmpty: No rules yet. Add them to ~/.opencapx/rules.json.
rulesTrustHint: Trusted projects — project-level rules only load for projects listed here.
pluginConfigHint: Settings for each plugin: pick one to open its page. Plugins that declare a settings form get a form; the rest are edited as keys / JSON.
dbRecoveryBody: The store could not be opened ({reason}), so it was moved aside and a fresh one was created. Settings, plugin config files and installed plugins are unaffected. Previous copy: {path}
pluginConfigResetConfirm: Reset this plugin's config to empty? This cannot be undone.
pluginValidatePattern: Does not match the required format.
pluginCfgUndeclaredHint: This plugin declares no settings form — the keys below are defined by its author; check the plugin README for what they mean.
installSandboxForced: Unsigned + sandbox declared: macOS sandbox enforcement will be forced on for this plugin.
installSandboxUnconfined: Unverified and no sandbox declared: this plugin will run with your full user permissions.
pluginUninstallConfirm: Uninstall this plugin? Config and permissions will be removed.
pluginUpdateFileIdMismatch: Package id "{got}" does not match plugin "{want}" — refusing to update.
pluginRevoked: Publisher key revoked — plugin disabled by default
pluginAllowUnsigned: Allow unsigned packages (at your own risk)
pluginUnsignedWarn: Unverified source — this package has no verifiable signature. Install only if you trust its origin.
pluginUnsignedAckHint: Tick the box above to enable the confirm button.
pluginHardDeny: Integrity check failed (tampered / bad signature) — this package cannot be installed.
pluginPublisherChangeBody: Publisher key changed — a new publisher takes over this plugin
uninstallHint: Uninstall will stop the process, remove managed plugin files, delete config + SQLite rows, and emit plugin.uninstalled.
rpcExportNoChains: This project has no request chains to export.
rpcExportDirUnwritable: Cannot write to the chosen directory.
statsHint: Capability call counts + p95 latency per plugin (last 200 samples each).
depGraphHint: Nodes = installed plugins, edges = shared capabilities. Hover a node to see its connections.
depGraphEmpty: No plugins installed yet — nothing to graph.
heatmapHint: Plugin × permission decision grid (✓ granted / ✗ denied / ? ask). High-risk permissions (process.execute / filesystem.write / microphone / camera) get a red border. Below: top-denied permissions across all plugins.
replayHint: Recorded event sessions. Click ▶ to replay a session live into the activity timeline; click ⬇ to download it for offline analysis.
slaHint: Capability SLA monitor. Polls every pollSecs, scans last windowSecs of capability_stats. If ok p95 > threshold ms OR fail rate > threshold % over ≥10 samples, emits capability.sla.violated (deduped per pair per window).
slaViolationsHint: Recent violations (audit timeline also captures these as capability.sla.violated).
probeNever: No probe run yet for this plugin.
channelDefaultHint: Channel used by default for installed plugins when checking updates.
channelSelectHint: Plugin self-update channel (stable = production, dev = bleeding edge)
hotkeysHint: Click a shortcut to record a new combo. Esc cancels; Delete clears a binding. Failed OS registrations are marked and retried at launch.
hotkeyRecordHint: Press a key combination including at least one modifier.
hotkeyRecordNeedModifier: Need at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift / ⌘)
hotkeyRestoreConfirm: Some default combos are bound to other actions. Restore defaults and overwrite them?
hotkeyOverwriteConfirm: This combo is already bound to another action. Overwrite it?
hotkeyNotActiveHint: Registration at OS level failed — the combo may be taken by another app.
paletteBuiltinNote: Bind a hotkey to this built-in action from the Hotkeys tab. Selected:
palettePluginNote: Bind a hotkey to invoke this plugin capability:
healthHint: Tune watchdog per plugin: ping interval, retry limit, initial backoff, total switch. Defaults match the legacy global policy.
backupHint: Snapshot workspace state (plugins, hotkeys, channels, health configs, plugin configs) into a JSON file. Restore replaces all workspace state.
backupRestoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Current workspace state will be replaced.
lifecyclePlanHint: Topological start plan based on shared capabilities. Plugins in the same layer can start in parallel; cycles (sharing with each other) are bundled together. Stop order is reverse of start.
lifecycleStartConfirm: Start all installed plugins in topological order?
lifecycleStopConfirm: Stop all running plugins in reverse topological order?
killSwitchHint: Global emergency stop: when ON, all plugins are immediately stopped and any new start is rejected. Use to halt runaway plugins without uninstalling.
killSwitchInactive: ✓ Kill switch inactive (plugins can start normally)
killSwitchConfirmEnable: Engage kill switch? All running plugins will be force-stopped immediately.
killSwitchConfirmDisable: Disengage kill switch? You can manually restart plugins afterward.
safeModeHint: Diagnostic startup: launch with --safe-mode to run the app without third-party plugins (Core and built-in capabilities stay on). Exit by restarting normally.
safeModeActive: ⚠ Safe mode active — third-party plugins are not loaded
cliCommandHint: Run opencapx from any terminal — agent setup, sandbox, rules and plugin signing. Adds a symlink in /usr/local/bin; agent hooks and MCP entries already work without it.
cliCommandUnsupported: Not supported on this platform — add the shim directory to PATH manually
metricsHint: Live CPU / memory / thread / fd counts for running plugin processes. Polled every pollSecs; breach of cpuPctMax / rssBytesMax / threadCountMax triggers a dedup'd plugin.metrics.exceeded event.
metricsEmpty: No running plugins — start one to see metrics.
metricsThresholdsHint: Card border turns yellow at 80% of any threshold, red when exceeded. Set a value to 0 to disable that rule.
profilesHint: Each profile has its own plugins / permissions / configs / hotkeys. Switching stops all running plugins and reloads state from the new workspace.
profilesSwitchConfirm: Switch to profile "{name}"? All running plugins will be stopped.
profilesDeleteConfirm: Delete profile "{name}" and its SQLite database? Cannot be undone.
alertingHint: Forward critical events (metric breach / SLA violation / kill-switch / crash) to an external webhook (Slack / Discord / custom). Same source + payload within min_interval_secs is deduplicated.
alertingHeadersHint: No headers — click "Add header" to attach auth / routing headers.
alertingEndpointsHint: Endpoints — each event fans out to every enabled endpoint with matching source filter. Set a HMAC-SHA256 secret to add an X-OpenCapX-Signature header.
alertingEndpointsEmpty: No endpoints yet. Click Add endpoint to fan out alerts to Slack / Discord / OpsGenie / custom.
alertingEndpointSeverityOverridesHint: Override this endpoint's severity for specific sources or patterns (glob like `plugin.*`). Wins over user hints and propagation. First match wins.
alertingSeverityPreviewHint: Enter a source and pick an endpoint (or All enabled) to see which severity each endpoint will receive, and which override (if any) wins.
alertingDispatchSimulateHint: Enter a source and optional JSON payload to preview what each link (route → correlation → aggregation → escalation → endpoint fanout) would do — no state changes, no HTTP.
alertingDispatchSimulateWouldBeDropped: Event would be dropped at the gates (before route / aggregation / correlation / escalation).
alertingEndpointDeleteConfirm: Delete this endpoint and its failed deliveries?
alertingSilencesHint: Silences — temporarily suppress events that match a kind pattern during a time window. Silences have highest priority: even if dedup hasn't expired, matching events are dropped before fanout.
alertingSilencesEmpty: No silences. Add one to suppress noisy alerts during maintenance windows.
alertingSilenceHoursPrompt: Hour range (UTC, 0-24, e.g. 0-6 for early-morning only):
alertingSilenceHoursInvalid: Invalid hour range or day count
alertingAcksHint: Acks — temporary suppression that expires automatically. Use during incident response to silence noisy alerts without committing to a long silence window.
alertingAcksEmpty: No acks. Add an ack with a kind pattern + window in minutes to suppress matching events.
alertingAckWindowInvalid: Window must be a positive number of minutes
alertingRoutesHint: DSL routing rules — when an event matches a rule (by kind + optional payload match), it routes only to that rule's target endpoints (skipping fanout). Lower priority = checked first. First enabled match wins. Rules export to YAML for version control.
alertingRoutesEmpty: No rules. Add one to selectively route events to specific endpoints. Without rules, all enabled endpoints receive all matching events.
alertingRouteTargetPrompt: Target endpoint ids (comma-separated; paste id or `id(name)`):
alertingRouteTargetRequired: At least one target endpoint required
alertingRouteNeedEndpoint: Create at least one endpoint first
alertingRecipientKindLogStderrHint: Writes JSON alert lines to stderr. Use for local debug only.
alertingRecipientKindLogFileHint: Appends JSON alert lines to a file. Use ${path} placeholder for path.
alertingRecipientKindEmailSmtpHint: Format: email:smtp:{relay}:{port}:{from}:{to}. Phase 66 is a mock — real SMTP in Phase 67+.
alertingRecipientWebhookRefHint: Format: webhook:{endpoint_id}. Endpoint must exist in your endpoint list.
alertingRecipientsHint: Recipients — multi-channel fanout (webhook / log:stderr / log:file / email:smtp)
alertingRecipientsEmpty: No recipients yet. Click "Recipient" above to add one.
alertingRecipientCardDeleteConfirm: Delete this recipient? Routes referencing it will be auto-cleaned.
alertingRouteSeenInLastLabel: Temporal correlation (only fire if recent event matched):
alertingRouteSeenInLastPrompt:
Format: pattern|window_secs
Example: plugin.metrics.*|60
Leave blank to clear.
alertingCorrelationSectionTitle: Correlation — detect cycles + view recent events
alertingSeverityCascadeConfirm: Delete this severity hint and clear all references?
alertingSeverityCascadeDone: Cascade complete: deleted {deleted} hint, affected routes=[{routes}], correlations=[{correlations}], aggregations=[{aggregations}].
alertingSeverityPropagationBanner: Severity hints now propagate to route / correlation / aggregation / escalation in real time.
alertingSchemaVersionHint: v1 wraps payload in a canonical envelope with eventId, severity, schemaVersion, tags, timestamp
alertingEndpointTemplateHint: Custom body. Placeholders: {{source}} {{eventId}} {{severity}} {{timestamp}} {{tags.k}} {{payload.x.y}}. Blocks: {{#if EXPR}}A{{else}}B{{/if}}, {{#each payload.items}}...{{this.x}}{{/each}}. Content-Type is auto-detected from first non-space char: '{' or '[' → application/json, else text/plain.
alertingEndpointTemplatePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the schema's default envelope.
alertingEndpointTemplateContentType: Body is sent verbatim; signing/signature still applies over the rendered body.
alertingEndpointTemplateSampleHint: Used as envelope.payload for the preview. Try the structure of a typical event so {{payload.x.y}} hits something.
alertingEndpointTemplatePreviewDisabled: Enable the per-endpoint template toggle to see the live preview.
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetBarHint: Pick a preset to fill the template + sample, or save the current one for later.
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetSaveTitle: Save current template + sample as preset
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetExportTitl: Export all presets to YAML / JSON
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetSaveEmpty: Template is empty — toggle on and write something first.
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetDeleteProm: Type the number of the preset to delete:
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetForkTitle: Fork a built-in preset into a new editable copy
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetForkPrompt: Which built-in preset to fork? Type the number (1–5) or the kind (e.g. builtin:slack):
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetForkInvali: Invalid choice — type a number 1–5 or a 'builtin:*' kind.
alertingEndpointTemplatePresetForkNamePr: Name for the new forked preset:
alertingBundleExportTitle: Export full alerting configuration (endpoints + routes + presets + silences + acks) to YAML
alertingBundleImportTitle: Import a full alerting configuration bundle from YAML
alertingBundlePassphrasePrompt:
Optional passphrase to encrypt the bundle (AES-256-GCM).
Leave blank for plaintext signed YAML only.
(Remember this passphrase — it cannot be recovered.)
alertingBundleEncryptedRequiresPassphras: This bundle is passphrase-encrypted. Enter the passphrase:
alertingBundleRotateTitle: Rotate bundle signing secret (invalidates previously exported bundles)
alertingBundleRotateConfirm: Rotate signing secret? Existing bundle exports will fail verification until you re-sign and re-import them.
alertingBundleRotated: ✓ Signing secret rotated. Re-export your bundle to capture the new signature.
alertingSeverityHintsHint: Per-source severity (user hint beats manifest hint, both beat built-in defaults)
alertingAggregationsHint: Frequency thresholds — downgrade / suppress / merge repeated events from the same source
alertingAggregationInvalid: Window seconds and threshold count must be > 0
alertingCorrelationsHint: Cross-event suppression — when A happens, suppress B within the window (e.g. suppress lifecycle.crashed for 30s after lifecycle.started)
alertingEscalationsHint: Escalation chain — re-fire to a higher severity when an event has been un-acked for longer than the threshold (background poller every 15s)
